findings.impact: Map-transfer pending/decode ownership regression, not a proven sole cause of sustained sub-30 mobile FPS.
findings.before: Generic SceneLoader promise returned false after release while a real pending Meshopt import left scene pending=1. It reached zero only after the decoder gate was released.
findings.fix: The same owned loadMapContainer/MapLoadLifetime signal path as streamed map assets; cancellation disposes partial resources and guards late buffer publication.

findings.impact: Avoidable draw submissions, geometry and vertex work for ground point markers.
findings.before: Actual Babylon 9.31 torus tessellation24 produces 1250 triangles, not the initially estimated 1152. 24 individually created rings submitted 24 draws and held 24 unique geometries.
findings.fix: A 24-segment flat annulus, 48 triangles, one shared geometry and native instancing. In the same 24-marker fixture: one draw with 24 instances. Ground-circle width/radius remain unchanged; the tube cross-section is intentionally flattened.

findings.impact: Unnecessary foreground preparation and retained hidden quest models.
findings.before: The initial 01fa3ba points required importing all 4 village / 7 forest unique model IDs even when distant, ineligible or already collected. Later root additions are outside those historical counts.
findings.fix: Only near+eligible/FoW-visible demand starts a model. One model loads at a time. Failed models never retry on periodic updates; explicit map lifecycle restart permits retry. Marker/interaction fallback remains available, with isReady(point) for root interaction gating.

findings.impact: First-visible shader compilation and missing environment registration.
findings.before: Generic props did not register source receivers, attach cave paint/FoW or prepare the instanced material/ink variant before exposure.
findings.fix: Register sources, preserve authored mesh/UV/texture profile, apply toon, attach cave PBR paint/FoW, warm the actual PBR and ink variants, then publish frozen native instances. Failed ink preparation never adds source callbacks or records to the live outline.

ruledOutOrLimited: Historical hidden AssetContainer source meshes were not in scene; hidden instances produced active=0. No ghost-origin render claim.

Quest visit facts use persistent dedupe tokens; cumulative gold credits return before storage writes when the total is unchanged. No evidence of unconditional localStorage writes every 0.15s during ordinary exploration.
The compared normal village/forest paths do not raise render distance, target FPS, device pixel ratio or player texture profile. Plains-only geometry/decor is gated by world.plains.
New quest DOM updates are throttled to 0.15s and the tracked label uses a signature guard. Browser compositor/font cost was not measured, and this audit does not declare it zero.
An old November 1 cave diagnostic is not evidence of current village/forest regression. No actual phone GPU/FPS/temperature improvement was measured.
